record.question: Which part of Renal Tubule is impermeable to water?
options: Ascending limb of loop of Hanle
Descending limb of loop of Hanle
record.explanation: Answer C: Ascending limb of loop of Hanle. The ascending limb of the loop of Henle is relatively impermeable to water, while the descending limb is water-permeable. “Ascending limb” is broad; the thick ascending limb is the classic water-impermeable segment. Reference: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pathway/PathBank%3ASMP0121009. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
